ns2:section.sectionText: CAREER PREPARATION FOR SINGERS AND VOCAL COACHES This class will focus on the practical side of becoming a professional singer or member of a music staff. Meetings will consist of regular mock auditions, student presentations on American opera houses and young artists¿ programs, and lectures/discussion by Dr. Gunn and guests about the structure and nature of our industry. It is understood that enrollment in this class means that a student is highly motivated to begin a career as a singer or coach/conductor in the near future.
